quickCards.title: Boil-Water Notice Quick Loop
quickCards.summary: Separate untreated water, treated water, and kitchen flow before anyone starts pouring from the wrong container.
quickCards.bodyMarkdown:
## Set The Lane
- Pick one clean area for treated water only.
- Keep untreated containers outside that lane.

## Treat And Cool
- Use one method you already trust and know how to run safely.
- Cool treated water in covered containers.

## Rejoin Household Use
- Mark treated containers clearly.
- Refill the daily-use area from treated water only.

## Do Not
- Mix untreated and treated containers on the same counter.
- Assume everyone knows which jug is safe without a label.

quickCards.title: Water Rotation Reset
quickCards.summary: Rotate the oldest labeled water first and update the inventory record before the day ends.
quickCards.bodyMarkdown:
## Start With Dates
- Pull the oldest labeled containers first.
- Check seals, cloudiness, and storage damage.

## Refill In Order
- Refill the containers you use most often first.
- Re-label anything that lost its date or use tag.

## Close The Loop
- Update the Inventory tab the same day.
- Move the newest fill dates to the back of the storage line.

## Do Not
- Leave unlabeled containers mixed into the rotation shelf.
- Wait for the next outage to discover what is stale.
